title: ZombieChaos
description: Adds unique zombie variants made in a seamless Vanilla+ style with custom models and tactical abilities.
body:
![Zombie_1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62f52634b1bff5a31aaa4d26b1b4a53a7aa5799a_0.webp)

---

**ZombieChaos** - introduces a variety of challenging zombie variants that are significantly more dangerous than their vanilla counterparts. These new creatures possess unique tactical abilities, such as throwing splash potions, releasing angry swarms of bees, launching projectable carrots, and performing devastating ground smashes. With this mod installed, nighttime exploration becomes much tougher and completely unpredictable, as these threats naturally spawn across every single biome in the Overworld!
